notes.title: Updated to Version 1.6!
notes.notes:
I made some minor adjustments and fixed some small bugs plaguing the Steam version of King of the Cul-de-sac!


Added Autosave Notification - KotC has always had autosaving running in the background, but now it's actually communicated to the user instead of keeping it secret for some reason.
Fixed a hidden button issue! - One of my hacky solutions to making the game work better with touch devices was to add invisible buttons all over the place (gross, I know).  I've fixed some instances of the invisible buttons not disappearing after pressed, so hopefully no random buttons that send you back a chapter.
Assured Readers they're doing a good job! - The original ending feedback to users was "try picking different options next time", which now that I say it aloud, sounds like I was saying they did something wrong.  There are no bad endings, and no wrong decisions you can make, and the new feedback for first time players reflects that!
